title: Primitive Recursiveness of Binary Evaluation
statement: The function that assigns to each finite Boolean string its binary value, reading the string from least significant bit to most significant bit, is primitive recursive. A string $b_0b_1\cdots b_{k-1}$ is assigned the value $\sum_{j<k} b_j2^j$, where each Boolean is interpreted as $0$ or $1$.
replaced:
The function evaluating a Boolean string as a natural number written with the
least-significant bit first (the fold of the bit-append operation
$(b, n) \mapsto 2n + b$ over the string, starting from $0$) is primitive recursive.
